answer: Locks are recorded in willow, expire in garden, and copper lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An adversary running 181 aliases thus needs 165 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2286 identities would post 3142 proofs and burn roughly 54 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
